question: Coking coal is on the EU list of critical raw materials, but not on the list of strategic ones. The Commission is due to review the list of strategic raw materials by 24 May 2027. 1.

Between 2023 and 2026, did Poland apply to the Commission or the European Critical Raw Materials Board for coking coal to be granted strategic raw material status? If so, when and on the basis of which documents?

Has the Polish Government advised the Commission as to whether it has examined the possibility of classifying coking coal as a raw material meeting the criteria for strategic importance? If so, please provide the results of this analysis or indicate the publication in which they have been published.
Does the Commission know whether Poland intends to submit its position on this matter ahead of the review scheduled for 2027?
